questions.question: 在下面代码中，哪一部分属于页面主体内容？为什么？
questions.knowledgePoint: HTML 文档结构（head 与 body）
questions.answerExplanation: 页面主体内容是 `<body>` 内的内容。`<head>` 主要放文档元信息（标题、meta、样式链接等），不是给用户直接阅读的主内容区域。

questions.question:
`
Course Notes
` 和 `

Course Notes

` 哪个更适合作为页面主标题？为什么？
questions.knowledgePoint: HTML 语义标签（标题层级）
questions.answerExplanation: `<h1>` 更合适，因为它明确表达「一级标题」的语义；`<div>` 是通用容器，不表达标题意义。

questions.question: `` 在什么情况下会加载失败？请从路径角度解释。
questions.answerExplanation: 这是相对路径写法，浏览器会从当前 HTML 文件所在目录查找 `logo.png`。当目录层级变化或文件不在预期位置时会失败。

questions.question: 课程 logo 图片使用 `alt="image"` 是否合适？如果不合适，怎么改？
questions.knowledgePoint: 图片可访问性（alt 文本）
questions.answerExplanation: 不合适。`image` 信息过于空泛，建议使用有意义的描述，例如 `alt="COMP6080 course logo"`。`alt` 应帮助用户理解图片信息。

questions.question: 比较 `src="images/photo.jpg"` 与 `src="/images/photo.jpg"` 的区别。
questions.answerExplanation: 前者是相对路径，基于当前页面目录；后者是根路径，基于站点根目录。页面迁移到子目录时，相对路径更容易受影响。

questions.question: 为什么课程图标或线条图常推荐 SVG，而不是 PNG？
questions.answerExplanation: SVG 是矢量图，缩放后通常更清晰，适合图标、logo、线条图；PNG 是位图，放大后更容易失真。

questions.question: 这句话对不对？「SVG 和 JPG 的主要区别只是后缀不同。」
questions.answerExplanation: 不对。二者在图像表示方式上不同：SVG 是矢量描述，JPG 是位图像素数据，适用场景和缩放表现不同。

questions.question: 下面两种结构，哪种更有语义？为什么？
questions.answerExplanation: 第二种更有语义。`header/nav/footer` 明确表达页面区域角色，结构可读性和后续维护性更好。

questions.question: `<code>` 和 `<pre>` 有什么区别？为什么常一起使用？
questions.answerExplanation: `<code>` 用于表达「这是一段代码」，`<pre>` 用于保留空格与换行格式。一起用能同时表达语义和格式。

questions.question: 为什么 `<meta>` 一般放在 `<head>` 而不是 `<body>`？
questions.answerExplanation: `<meta>` 是文档元信息（编码、描述、视口等），属于文档头部配置，不是页面主体内容。

questions.question: 比较下面两种链接，当页面移动到子目录时，哪个更容易出问题？
questions.answerExplanation: `about.html`（相对路径）更容易受目录变化影响；`/about`（根路径）始终从站点根目录解析。

questions.question: 指出下面代码的两个问题，并给出修正写法。
questions.answerExplanation: 问题 1：路径或文件名不完整，可能无法正确加载；问题 2：缺少 `alt`。可改为 ``。

questions.question: 下面文本最终显示什么颜色？为什么？
questions.knowledgePoint: 选择器优先级（元素 vs 类）
questions.answerExplanation: 显示红色。类选择器 `.note` 的优先级高于元素选择器 `p`。

questions.question: 外部样式、内部样式、行内样式三种方式中，项目开发里最常用哪种？为什么？
questions.answerExplanation: 最常用外部样式文件，因为便于复用、组织和维护。内部/行内样式更适合临时场景。

questions.question: 为什么以下样式不会命中目标元素？
questions.knowledgePoint: id 选择器与 class 选择器匹配
questions.answerExplanation: `#warning` 是 id 选择器，但 HTML 给的是 class。应改成 `.warning` 或把 HTML 改为 `id="warning"`。

questions.question: 按钮太「挤」时，优先调 `margin` 还是 `padding`？为什么？
questions.answerExplanation: 优先调 `padding`，因为它增加按钮内部留白和可点击区域；`margin` 主要改变元素与外部元素的间距。

questions.question: 如果要让段落「更大、更清晰、更醒目」，应优先考虑哪些 CSS 属性？
questions.answerExplanation: 通常优先 `font-size`、`font-weight`、`font-family`，必要时再配合 `line-height` 和颜色。

questions.question: 解释为什么「元素设置了 `width: 200px`，最终占宽不一定是 200px」。
questions.answerExplanation: 默认盒模型下，`width` 只表示内容宽度，总占宽通常还包括左右 `padding` 和左右 `border`。

questions.question: 为什么「当前看起来对齐了」不等于布局没问题？
questions.knowledgePoint: 布局稳定性与响应变化
questions.answerExplanation: 布局需要适应不同屏幕宽度和内容长度。仅在当前尺寸下看起来正常，不能证明布局在其他场景也稳定。

questions.question: `display: flex` 通常写在父元素还是子元素？分别会影响什么？
questions.knowledgePoint: Flex 容器与 Flex 子项
questions.answerExplanation: 通常写在父元素，用于控制子元素排列。写在子元素时，影响的是该子元素内部内容布局，不是兄弟元素之间布局。

questions.question: `justify-content` 与 `align-items` 的区别是什么？
questions.answerExplanation: `justify-content` 控制主轴分布，`align-items` 控制交叉轴对齐。先确认主轴方向，再判断用哪个属性。

questions.question: 一组横向卡片布局，为什么通常用 Flexbox 比「每张卡片写死 margin-left」更稳？
questions.answerExplanation: Flexbox 能根据可用空间自动分配和对齐，适应性更好；写死边距在屏幕变化时更容易错位。

questions.question: 这句话对不对？「只要写 `z-index: 9999`，元素一定在最上层。」
questions.answerExplanation: 不对。`z-index` 受定位条件和层叠上下文影响，不是单纯比数字大小。

questions.question: 元素写了 `z-index: 10` 却没变化，常见原因有哪些？
questions.answerExplanation: 常见原因包括未处于合适定位环境、与目标元素不在同一层叠上下文、被父层叠关系限制。

questions.question: 预处理器在样式维护上的核心价值是什么？
questions.answerExplanation: 通过变量、嵌套、复用减少重复代码，提升统一修改效率，尤其适合样式规模较大的项目。

questions.question: 这句话对不对？「有变量和嵌套就说明预处理器本质上等于 JavaScript。」
questions.answerExplanation: 不对。预处理器是 CSS 的增强与编译前处理工具，不是通用脚本语言。

questions.question:
A badge is positioned over a photo. ```html
NEW
``` ```css .phone { width: 400px; margin: 0 auto; } .hero { position: relative; height: 300px; } .photo { width: 100%; height: 100%; object-fit: cover; } .badge { position: absolute; top: 20px; right: 20px; width: 80px; height: 40px; } ``` (a) The badge is positioned 20px from the hero's right edge. How many pixels from the hero's left edge is the badge's left edge? Show where the hero's width comes from and why it is needed for the calculation. (b) The developer removes position relative from the hero. Where does the badge move, and what are top and right now measured against?
questions.answerExplanation:
(a) 300px. right: 20px pins the badge's RIGHT edge 20px in from the hero's right edge, and the badge is 80px wide, so its left edge sits at: 400 - 20 - 80 = 300px.
(b) The badge ends up in the top right corner of the page — 20px from the top and 20px from the right of the window — rather than in the corner of the hero. Absolute will attach to the nearest previous relative.

questions.question:
Determine the size and spacing of the two blocks below. Each element has its natural height unless a height is specified, and the page is wider than 600px.
```css
.card { width: 400px; padding: 0 20px; border: 2px solid #333333; margin-bottom: 40px; }
```
(a) Calculate the card's total width in pixels, showing your working. Then state its total width if box-sizing were set to border-box.
questions.answerExplanation: 444px. width: 400px sets the CONTENT box, because box-sizing defaults to content-box. The padding and the border are then added outside it: 400 (content) + 20 + 20 (padding) + 2 + 2 (border) = 444px. If box-sizing were border-box, the total width would be exactly 400px.

Trip to Sydney

``` (a) Where does the text "My Trip" appear, and where does "Trip to Sydney" appear? (b) The developer wants the list to be numbered 1, 2 instead of using bullet points. What should they change?
questions.answerExplanation: (a) "My Trip" appears in the browser tab, because it is inside in the head. "Trip to Sydney" appears on the page itself as the main heading, because it is inside <h1> in the body. (b) Change <ul> to <ol> (and </ul> to </ol>). ul is an unordered list shown with bullets; ol is an ordered list shown with numbers.

questions.question:
A developer chooses image formats for a website. The site needs three images:
- a large photo of a beach at sunset
- the company logo, with a transparent background, which must stay sharp at any size
- a small animated loading icon

(a) Choose the most suitable format for each image from JPG, PNG, GIF and SVG. Give a reason for each choice.
(b) The developer saves the beach photo as a PNG instead, and the file is about five times bigger. It also looks no better. Explain why.
(c) Someone saves the logo as a JPG instead. On the site's dark blue header it now has a white box around it, and it looks blurry when shown larger. Explain both problems.
questions.answerExplanation:
(a) Beach photo: JPG. It uses lossy compression, which keeps photos with lots of colours and detail at a small file size. Logo: SVG. It is a vector format, so it stays sharp at any size, and it supports transparency. Loading icon: GIF. It supports simple animation.
(b) PNG is lossless, so it keeps every pixel exactly. A photo has lots of fine detail and colour changes, which lossless compression cannot shrink well. JPG throws away detail the eye barely notices, so it is much smaller while looking almost the same.
(c) White box: JPG does not support transparency, so the transparent background is filled in with a solid colour (white). Blurry: JPG is a raster format made of a fixed number of pixels. Showing it larger stretches those pixels, so it looks blurry or blocky. An SVG is drawn from shapes, so it can be redrawn sharply at any size.
